items.title: Father Al Lewis Interview, 1972-02-21
items.q: I see one night that old man Humphrey Willis' daddy was on the boat.

ctx.x: No, no, me talking about children, they used to be bringing in children. We used to have some, but I see one night that old man Humphrey Willis' daddy was on the boat. He made a trip in Martin Cole's place, and we went out there and got drunk. He said, you know, the bitch looked like he was going to put, you know, the bonkers, he said, watch out, don't you drive?
He slept on the boat, huh? Yeah, he slept eight on the boat. They had two or three good cooks, catch that big old fish right out there, the red river and the river, you know, and everything.
